# GEMS Profino

> GEMS Profino is a loan facilitator based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. It helps people and businesses get home loans, loans against property, business loans and car loans by matching each application with a suitable lender from a network of 100+ banks and NBFCs, preparing the paperwork and following the file until the loan is paid out.

GEMS Profino is not a bank, NBFC or lender and does not lend money. Loan approval, interest rate and final terms are decided by the lending bank or NBFC. GEMS Profino does not quote interest rates.

- Based in: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- Serves: Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana
- Doorstep document collection: Chennai and Tamil Nadu
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9am to 9pm
- Callback: within 30 minutes of an enquiry, during business hours
- To start an application: Aadhaar, PAN card and 6 months of bank statements
- Balance transfer: available on every loan type
- Enquiring does not affect the applicant's credit score
- Language: English
- Email: gemsprofino@gmail.com

## Loans

- [Home Loan in Chennai](https://www.gemsprofino.com/home-loan.html): buying a flat, plot or house, construction, renovation, top-up and home loan balance transfer, for salaried and self-employed applicants
- [Loan Against Property in Chennai](https://www.gemsprofino.com/property-loan.html): borrowing against a house, flat, shop or plot the applicant already owns
- [Business Loan in Chennai](https://www.gemsprofino.com/business-loan.html): working capital, expansion and machinery, with or without property as security
- [Car Loan in Chennai](https://www.gemsprofino.com/car-loan.html): new and used cars, from a showroom, dealer or private seller, plus refinance on a car already owned
